info.title: AI Service API
info.description: Book recommendations produced by the RAG pipeline behind this service (ADR-0002). REST endpoints are proxied to ai.v1.AiService over gRPC. Every method expects the header 'authorization: Bearer <token>' with the token returned by the user-service Login; reindexing methods additionally require the LIBRARIAN role.

tags.name: AiService
tags.description:
Book recommendations over the catalogue, plus the index maintenance the
catalogue synchronisation needs.

Every RPC is also exposed as a REST endpoint through grpc-gateway, which is
what the Swagger UI at /swagger/ exercises. Every method refuses a request
without a valid bearer token with UNAUTHENTICATED; the index maintenance
methods additionally require the LIBRARIAN role and answer PERMISSION_DENIED
otherwise.

delete.summary: Drops one catalogue entry from the vector store.

post.summary:
Reindexes one catalogue entry: the book is read from book-service and
handed to the indexing pipeline again.

parameters.name: bookId
parameters.description: Identifier of the book in the catalogue, the id used by book-service.

get.summary: Reports what the vector store currently holds.

post.summary: Answers a free-text query with recommendations from the catalogue.

deleted.description: False when the book was not indexed in the first place.

indexedBooks.description: Catalogue entries present in the vector store.

indexedChunks.description: Chunks present in the vector store.

title.description: Title the record was indexed under, as read back from book-service.

query.description: What the reader is looking for, in free text.

sessionId.description: Conversation to continue, empty starts a new one.

limit.description:
How many catalogue entries the answer may list, 0 means the service
default (5), capped at 20.

query.description: The query the recommendation was produced for.

answer.description: Natural-language answer of the pipeline, empty for a retrieval-only reply.

sessionId.description: Conversation id to send back for a follow-up question.

v1Recommendation.description: Recommendation is the answer to one query.

v1RecommendationSource.description:
Where a recommendation came from. The value tells the caller how much to
trust the answer and how much it cost: an LLM answer is grounded in the
catalogue but paid for, a retrieval answer is free but not phrased.

 - RECOMMENDATION_SOURCE_GENERATED: The RAG pipeline answered: retrieved books plus a generated text.
 - RECOMMENDATION_SOURCE_RETRIEVAL: The pipeline produced no text, the titles were taken from retrieval only.

v1RecommendedBook.description:
RecommendedBook is one catalogue entry the pipeline picked for the query.
Only identity fields travel: the caller resolves the rest through
book-service, which is the source of truth for the catalogue.

BearerAuth.description: Session token returned by the user-service Login, sent as 'Bearer <token>'.
BearerAuth.name: authorization
